title: Lesson One: The Rich Don't Work for Money
coreMove: Before chasing a raise, name the fear or desire pushing you, then seek an asset move that teaches and can keep paying long after your hour ends.

exampleSpecs.audience: a worker reacting to low pay
exampleSpecs.stakes: The 10 cents an hour and Saturday work can expose whether anger studies the wage trap or only demands relief.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show low pay in Hawaii revealing fear, anger, and the pull of a raise.

exampleSpecs.audience: a young learner with energy but little financial knowledge
exampleSpecs.stakes: The toothpaste tubes and counterfeit coins separate initiative from informed financial thinking.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Treat the failed coin casting as action needing education, not as proof that initiative is bad.

exampleSpecs.audience: a learner spotting a resource others ignore
exampleSpecs.stakes: Comic books can become a small library once the demand for hourly pay loosens.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show discarded comic books becoming access income instead of another paid hour.

exampleSpecs.audience: a worker offered more pay during frustration
exampleSpecs.stakes: More pay may soothe desire while leaving the wage trap unexamined.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the raise offer as a test of whether money can buy away the lesson.

exampleSpecs.audience: an employee angry at the payer
exampleSpecs.stakes: Blame can keep attention on the boss while the paycheck pattern repeats.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Move responsibility back to the learner without blaming employees for hardship.

exampleSpecs.audience: a student expecting a direct explanation
exampleSpecs.stakes: Experience can teach fear, anger, and waiting in a way a lecture cannot.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show silence and unpaid discomfort becoming the lesson rather than a failure to teach.

exampleSpecs.audience: a worker comparing hourly labor with an income mechanism
exampleSpecs.stakes: Money working for the owner requires learning, selection, and maintenance before it produces.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Contrast another paid hour with a small system that can earn after the hour ends.
